keys.name: Example service login
keys.note: Use as EXAMPLE_SERVICE_TOKEN. A Keychain item; presence is read from its metadata, never its value.

keys.name: Example API key
keys.note: Use as EXAMPLE_API_KEY. Exported in the zsh rc files.

keys.name: Example signing key
keys.note: Use as EXAMPLE_SIGNING_KEY. An owner-only file; presence is its size, its content is never read.

keys.name: Example deploy token
keys.reference: GitHub Actions secret EXAMPLE_DEPLOY_TOKEN in owner/repo
keys.note: Use as EXAMPLE_DEPLOY_TOKEN. A place Vitals cannot read; the workflow job below shows whether it still works.
